content:
tara: quick note — saw intermittent missing req ids in node sampleapp during startup. example log:
```
INFO server=start
INFO path=/health
INFO processed tokens=0
```
no req_id field like before.

jon: is this only node? go sampleapp still shows req_id. sounds like an SDK parity/init ordering bug.

eli: i can repro locally if OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.0 and loglevel=info. looks timing-related during boot.

jon: hypothesis: our reqid attach hook is downstream of otel autoinit in node, and when the sampler drops the span, the context never gets populated before the logger emits.

tara: also saw truncated reqs at debug: "req=____". redactor seems to be matching partial tokens when logs are chunked.

eli: mitigation: set REDWOOD_REQID_FALLBACK=1 in staging so logger synthesizes a fallback req id until we patch. ops applied it to staging cluster.

jon: proposed fixes: 1) reorder node logger hooks to attach reqid first, 2) attach reqid from raw headers if present (not dependent on span), 3) tighten redactor regex to strict hyphenated UUIDs and add allowlist.

ci-bot: created CI matrix job telemetry-parity-node-go with sampler=[0.0,1.0] loglevel=[info,debug].

eli: opened PR with the hook reorder + unit test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/512 (draft)

ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy telemetry-reqid-fix to staging at 2026-03-22T10:00:00Z

tara: action items: eli land reorder + test, jon update redactor regex + docs, ci-bot run matrix. i'll monitor staging after canary. :eyes:
